title: Malik Nabers doesn't practice Friday, John Harbaugh calls it "part of the process"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Malik Nabers doesn't practice Friday, John Harbaugh calls it "part of the process"
sources.description: The first days of Giants training camp featured a lot of positive reports about how wide receiver Malik Nabers has healed from last season's torn ACL, but there were none to add to the list on Friday.
